name: IronClaw Skill Builder: Test Writer
description: Phase 4: IronClaw reads a Go file, identifies an untested function, writes a test for it, and documents the test-writing procedure as a reusable skill.
process: IMPORTANT: Check your Skill Library section above. If you already have a test-writer skill, follow its steps instead of improvising.
STEP 1: Read the file. Call: exec({"command": "/workspace/bin/rj-tool github_fetch owner=tinyland-inc repo=remote-juggler path=gateway/portal.go"})
STEP 2: From the ACTUAL content returned in Step 1, identify one exported function that would benefit from a unit test. Pick a function with clear inputs and outputs.
STEP 3: Write a Go test function for it. The test should cover at least: (a) a happy path, (b) an edge case. Use standard Go testing patterns (table-driven if appropriate).
STEP 4: Create the test file via rj-tool. First write to a temp file, then use github_update_file with --content-file to create gateway/portal_test.go on a new branch.
STEP 5: Document your test-writing procedure as a reusable skill between __skill__ and __end_skill__ markers. Include how you chose the function, structured the test, and handled file creation.
STEP 6: Write your reflection between __memory__ and __end_memory__ markers.

metrics.successCriteria: Agent read the file, identified an untested function, wrote a test, and output a __skill__ block documenting the test-writing procedure.
